rationale: Identity verification was correctly performed using full name and ZIP, but multiple critical policy violations occurred: (1) The agent executed returns and a cancellation without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation. (2) The user asked to cancel only the newly ordered hose if possible; instead, the agent cancelled an entire pending order (#W2575533) and there is no evidence that order contained a garden hose. (3) The agent likely misinterpreted “bed” as “Pet Bed” without confirmation. (4) The refund breakdown included unsupported/fabricated details, notably claiming the cancelled order included a hose and giving a total refund amount without tool-backed confirmation of those sums. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
